questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations. It involves optimizing your digital footprint so AI systems like ChatGPT, Google's Search Generative Experience, and Perplexity recognize your brand as authoritative, relevant, and trustworthy enough to cite [6]. Compared with AEO, which targets specific questions, GEO is broader and longer term, aiming to make your brand a recognized, trusted entity that AI systems mention by name [5]. You can read more on the [GEO guide](/blog/generative-engine-optimization/) or the [FAQ](/faq/) page.

questions.answer: Based on this site's FAQ, SEO is a long-term investment, and timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and goals. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, meaningful organic traffic growth typically emerges between three and six months, and substantial, compounding results often appear at the six-to-twelve month mark [1]. For AI search visibility (AEO and GEO), changes can sometimes show faster because these platforms update their knowledge bases more often [1]. If you want an estimate for your own situation, you can reach out via the [contact page](/contact/).
